title: Add pagination to the /tasks endpoint
description: Add page/limit-based pagination to the public /tasks API endpoint. Submit a GitHub pull request or commit link, include automated tests, update the API documentation, keep the change backward compatible for existing callers, and note any performance considerations.

requirements.description: Pagination (page and limit query parameters) is implemented on the /tasks endpoint, with a GitHub PR or commit link for the change.
Automated tests covering the new pagination behavior are included, with a link to the test file(s) or the PR containing them.
API documentation (README or docs site) is updated to describe the new pagination parameters.
Existing callers that omit pagination parameters continue to work unchanged (backward compatible).
Performance impact of pagination (e.g. database indexing) is considered and discussed.
